body_markdown:
MENLO PARK, Calif.


, Nov. 19, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Global talent solutions and business consulting firm Robert Half (NYSE: RHI) has been selected by Fortune as one of the[Best Workplaces for Parents 2026](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4827605-1&h=723956901&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnam02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%252Fbest-workplaces%252Fparents%252F2026%253Fcategory%253Dlarge%26data%3D05%257C02%257Ckellie.shadle%2540roberthalf.com%257C38e465d25c614b0e3e2e08df46364a3e%257C16532572d5674d678727f12f7bb6aed3%257C0%257C0%257C639306871142841160%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3DEci7RBD%252FwfM9yqy7TbXoaCyhSie8Fvh4XkHcDoAuFv0%253D%26reserved%3D0&a=Best+Workplaces+for+Parents+2026) . This award honors U.S. employers that provide the most inclusive, fair and supportive workplaces for working parents.


The Best Workplaces for Parents list is based on a survey of more than 650,000 parents who work for[Great Place to Work](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4827605-1&h=1435103636&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.greatplacetowork.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3D2023.100best%26utm_medium%3Dreferral%26utm_source%3Dpress-release%26utm_content%3D%26utm_term%3D20230404%26utm_audience%3Dall&a=Great+Place+to+Work) ® Certified companies. They were asked to evaluate the quality and consistency of their workplace experiences and programs such as parental leave, adoption benefits, childcare and dependent health care benefits.


"Being recognized as one of the Best Workplaces for Parents affirms our commitment to supporting our employees at every stage of their careers and personal lives," said M. Keith Waddell, President and Chief Executive Officer of Robert Half. "Our people remain our greatest strength and we're proud to provide the resources and programs to help them thrive at work and at home."


Robert Half's Support for Families program offers family planning benefits, adoption assistance, family planning coverage and resources for new mothers returning to work. The company also provides backup care for children and elders, discounts on tutoring, test prep and enrichment classes, free online mindfulness and yoga classes for the entire family, and access to college admissions coaching services.


"At Robert Half, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees, particularly parents and caregivers who need support for a healthy work-life integration," said JoLynn Conway-James, Senior Executive Director and Chief Administrative Officer at Robert Half. "We will continue to provide programs and resources tailored to meet their individual needs, helping them navigate the evolving demands of work and family life."


**FAQs**
**What is Fortune's Best Workplaces for Parents list?**
The award recognizes Great Place to Work® Certified™ companies based on feedback from more than 650,000 working parents about fair and supportive workplaces for parents.


**Why was Robert Half recognized?**
The recognition reflects Robert Half's commitment to creating an employee experience that adapts to the needs of employees at every stage of their careers and lives.


**How does Robert Half support parents?**
Robert Half offers comprehensive health and well-being benefits, paid parental leave, choice time off and a Support for Families program. Benefits and resources include adoption assistance, family planning coverage, resources for new mothers transitioning back to work, backup care for children and elders, and much more.


**About Robert Half**
Robert Half (NYSE: RHI) is the world's first and largest specialized talent solutions and business consulting firm, connecting highly skilled job seekers with rewarding opportunities at great companies. We offer contract talent and full-time placement solutions in the fields of finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative and customer support, and we also provide executive search services.


Robert Half is the parent company of Protiviti®, a global consulting firm that delivers internal audit, risk, business and technology consulting solutions. In the last 12 months, Robert Half has been recognized as one of America's Most Innovative Companies by Fortune and, with Protiviti, has been named a Fortune® Most Admired Company™ and one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For.
